title: Content Frames
slide_intent: Teach designers to relate the curvature of an image frame to the button so a viewer sees a family resemblance between the two shapes.
strategic_value: Using the button as a reference can keep the action and the imagery consistent as Instacart changes the featured food.
demonstration: A radius diagram and a Lunar New Year promotion pair an orange pill button with a food photograph in a gently rounded frame. The prose specifies a frame radius of approximately one quarter of the button radius.
practical_value: Use the stated proportion as a starting point for rounding a photograph or illustration frame in a promotion.
